description: This file defines an abstract base class 'FormElementBase' for Drupal form element plugins, providing common properties, validation, and autocomplete processing methods used in rendering and form handling within Drupal.

classes.name: FormElementBase
classes.description: An abstract class providing base functionality for Drupal form element plugins, including property handling, pattern validation, and autocomplete setup.

methods.name: valueCallback
methods.description: Default callback returning NULL for transforming element value.

methods.name: processPattern
methods.description: Processes the #pattern property, setting the pattern attribute and adding validation.

methods.name: validatePattern
methods.description: Validates the element's value against the specified pattern, setting an error if it does not match.

methods.name: processAutocomplete
methods.description: Sets up autocomplete functionality for form elements with specified route and parameters, including permission checks and attaching necessary libraries.
